questions.prompt: Which country did Britain fight in the Falklands War?
questions.fact: The conflict lasted ten weeks, and the defeat contributed directly to the fall of Argentina's military government.

questions.prompt: Which mineral is the main component of bone?
questions.fact: Bone is remodelled constantly, and an adult skeleton is largely replaced roughly every ten years.

questions.prompt: Which country hosts the Tour of Flanders?
questions.fact: Its short, brutally steep cobbled climbs are known as bergs, and several have their own fan followings.

questions.prompt: Which television series features a character called Michael Scofield?
questions.fact: Its premise was pitched years earlier and rejected as impossible to sustain past one season.

questions.prompt: Which country contains the source of the Blue Nile?
questions.fact: It contributes most of the Nile's water during flood season, which is why a dam there is so politically fraught.

questions.prompt: Which novel features a character called Josef K.?
questions.fact: The word Kafkaesque now describes the exact bureaucratic nightmare the book depicts.

questions.prompt: What does the acronym EV charging term kWh measure?
questions.fact: Power is measured in kilowatts; multiplying by time gives energy, which is what a battery actually stores.
